facts.text: The user asked for a 10-question MBTI simple test.
The user requested answers in English.
The user asked how to respond to the 10 questions so that the result would be ENFP, shown in a table.
The user asked, if the user is ENFP, which options to choose for each of the 10 questions, in an 11x1 table format.
The user asked to change the table format to a 1x11 table.
The user asked to add one extra row on the left that includes the label "ENFP".
The user asked to continue in the same way for the remaining 15 MBTI types.
